device.description: 10-bit 188.9 kSPS I2C SAR ADC with out-of-range alert output
device.note: adc101c021.pdf (SNAS446D) p.2 connection diagrams, p.4 pin descriptions and Table 2 package pinouts, p.5 operating ratings (VA 2.7-5.5 V, digital inputs 0-5.5 V regardless of VA), p.8 conversion time 1 us typ, p.16 straight binary, p.17-23 registers, p.23-25 I2C sequences, p.25 Table 3 slave addresses

registers.name: CONVERSION
registers.note: p.18: alert flag D15, 10-bit result D11:D2, reserved bits read 0

pages: p.2 connection diagrams, p.4 pin descriptions and Table 2 package pinouts, p.5 operating ratings (VA 2.7-5.5 V, digital inputs 0-5.5 V regardless of VA), p.8 conversion time 1 us typ, p.16 straight binary, p.17-23 registers, p.23-25 I2C sequences, p.25 Table 3 slave addresses
notModeled: ALERT output (open drain, polarity CONFIG.POLARITY, enable CONFIG.ALERT_PIN_EN): never asserted
analog input (the result is always the 0 V code 0x000)

conversion starts at the ACK of the address byte of a read (about 400 ns acquisition + 1 us typ conversion); the model starts the next conversion after each read of the result (1 us, the typical value: no maximum is given)
automatic conversion mode (CONFIG.CYCLE_TIME != 0) is modeled as continuous conversions, each lasting the cycle interval 1 / typical fconvert of the p.20 table (27 ... 0.4 ksps)
alert function: VHIGH/VLOW/VHYST comparison, setting of the ALERT_STATUS flags and of CONVERSION.ALERT_FLAG, VMIN/VMAX tracking in automatic mode (registers are stored only)
reserved bits of the 16-bit limit registers read 0, but VHIGH/VMIN reset to 0FFFh per the datasheet (bits 1:0 set); they are marked read-only so the reset value reads back as 0FFFh
I2C Hs-mode master code entry (00001xxx), quiet interface mode, automatic power-down between conversions
power-on reset brown-out behaviour (registers lost below 2.4 V)
variants: ADC101C027 shares the datasheet (SOT-6 with ADR0 instead of ALERT): own spec file. The datasheet also has an ADC101C021 VSSOP-8 (ADR0/ADR1 straps, 9 addresses) that is not in the skeleton's parts. ADC081C021/ADC121C021 are the pin-compatible 8/12-bit parts
